scope: Actual user/assistant plain-save without sending; preserved complete history, attachments, following messages, producing models/usage and manual provenance; selected original/edited HTTP continuation; independent editor drafts, actual close/restart before debounce, stale conflicts and explicit discard; native storage failure rejects close/backup and recovers; exact gzip recovery and owner deletion. Native file/confirmation and filesystem-failure boundaries are isolated fixtures; abrupt termination, maximum scale, broader accessibility and other platforms remain separate gates.
